Q001.cannot: No record captures a shopper who did not buy 5 kg atta; absent_event is not recorded, and bills (the shopper-count proxy) contain only purchases, so the number of shoppers who left without buying cannot be determined.

plans.covers: Recorded forecast demand for 5 kg atta in June 2026 (forecasts-june, method '28-day mean of recorded sales'); true demand and lost sales are not recorded, so this is a labelled stand-in for demand, not a measured lost-sales figure.
Recorded sales of 5 kg atta in June 2026 (daily-sales-june, one of the eleven followed items); sales are not demand, so any gap versus forecast is only a proxy for unmet demand.
11:00 shelf-audit observations for 5 kg atta in June 2026 (shelf-audits-june), used as the on-shelf availability evidence; shelf hours and the exact times a product was off shelf are not recorded.
Uses the recorded 28-day-mean forecast for toned milk 500 ml as a labelled stand-in for true demand; actual demand and lost sales are not recorded, so this is not a measured true-demand figure.
Recorded June 2026 daily units sold and revenue for toned milk 500 ml, the observed sales baseline against which the forecast stand-in is compared.

On days when the 11:00 shelf audit found toned milk empty, this records units and revenue of full cream milk as a labelled substitution stand-in; the records do not show that shoppers actually switched to it, and no other substitute purchases are identified.
Counts distinct approved-payment bills per day as a proxy for daily visitors (shopper_count); actual shopper identities and visits without a purchase are not recorded.

Q006.cannot: No record captures a shopper who did not complete a purchase; there is no abandoned-basket or shopper-identity record, so the number of shoppers who abandoned a basket at the till cannot be determined.

Q008.cannot: No customer identity or shopper linkage is recorded, so repeat visits and churn cannot be measured; bills are only a proxy for shoppers, and the records cannot distinguish a returning shopper from a different shopper.

plans.covers: Uses a bill as the stand-in for a shopper (basket_value/shopper_count proxy) and checks whether any single bill among the eleven followed items contains atta (any pack size), oil and dal together; no record identifies actual shoppers or links bills to customer identity.
Counts recorded complaints and their rupee amounts as a stand-in for customer dissatisfaction; no satisfaction score or customer identity is recorded.
Breaks recorded complaints down by kind (charged twice; debited but till said failed) to show what customers complained about.
Shows how recorded complaints were resolved (bank returned the money; refunded after store matched the credit by hand).
Counts approved June payments and their value as the recorded side of customer transactions; a bill stands in for a shopper, and no satisfaction rating is recorded.

Q011.cannot: No snacks category is recorded: the products table contains only the eleven followed items (atta, bread, curd, dal, milk, oil, rice and sugar), and no table has a category column, so snacks sales, stock or performance cannot be identified.

plans.covers: Recorded daily units and revenue for the eleven followed items are the only evidence available to compare a new product's sales with an existing product's sales; the records do not identify a product launch, its date, or any causal cannibalization, so this plan supplies the sales series needed to check the premise rather than proving it.
Recorded sales for the eleven followed items over 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28, showing which of those products are selling and which are not.
Recorded forecast demand and order quantities per product for 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28, used as the demand-side signal for range decisions.
Recorded write-off units per product over 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28, showing products whose recorded stock is being lost to damage or expiry.
On-shelf availability per product from the 11:00 shelf audits (twice weekly, Tuesdays and Fridays) over 2026-06-02 to 2026-06-26, using the on-shelf availability definition.

Q014.cannot: No record captures the time customers spend waiting in a till queue; the records contain bill and payment timestamps but no queue-entry or service-start times, so queue duration cannot be derived.

plans.covers: Forecasts cover 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28 only, so no recorded forecast exists for Diwali 2026; this plan checks the forecast table for Diwali dates and returns recorded forecast units if present, otherwise no rows, and actual Diwali sales are not recorded.

Q016.covers: Total units of ATTA-WW-5KG recorded as sold in daily-sales-june for June 2026 (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28), covering only the eleven followed items.

Q017.cannot: No table records shopper age or gender, and no table identifies customers; a bill is only a proxy for a shopper, so the age and gender mix cannot be determined.

Q018.cannot: No record captures shopper requests for products the store does not stock; there is no customer-request or non-stock-product inquiry table, and no table records a shopper who did not buy.

plans.covers: Identifies the June 2026 days on which recorded toned-milk units sold fell, using daily-sales-june for the eleven followed items.
Checks the 11:00 shelf-audit observations for toned milk on the identified low-sales days for an 'empty' status, as recorded evidence that could contradict the sales record.
Lists recorded warehouse stock corrections for toned milk with their stated reasons (cycle count variance or short pick: slot count variance) around the low-sales days.
Lists recorded write-offs of toned milk (damaged or expired) on the identified low-sales days.

Q019.covers: The records can show when toned-milk sales fell and any recorded shelf-empty audits, stock-adjustment reasons and write-offs on those days, but no table records the cause of a sales decline, so the reason itself is not recorded and can only be described from these recorded stand-ins.

Q020.cannot: No table records home-delivery or online orders; the records cover store sales, warehouse orders, deliveries and payments, but not the order channel for a shopper's purchase.

Q021.cannot: The records contain daily sales only for June 2026 (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28); there is no June 2025 sales data for Store 014 to compare against.

Q022.covers: Total sales in May 2026 as the sum of till-line amounts for the eleven followed items only (pos-lines-may-june), which is not the whole store's sales.

Q023.covers: Total revenue in rupees from 5 kg whole wheat atta (ATTA-WW-5KG) across daily-sales-june for June 2026, covering the eleven followed items only.

Q024.covers: Counts distinct bill IDs appearing on till lines with bill_ts from 2026-05-04 through 2026-05-31, covering only the eleven followed items.

Q025.cannot: No records cover March 2026: the payment records begin 2026-06-01 and the till-line records begin 2026-05-04, so the number of bills rung up in March 2026 is not recorded.

Q026.covers: Uses the 'Bills and takings' definition: average bill value is the average amount_inr of approved payments (one approved payment per June bill), over payments dated 2026-05-01 through 2026-06-30; note that pos-payments-june covers only 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28, so May 2026 payments are not recorded in this table.

Q027.covers: Total units sold across all eleven followed products in June 2026 from daily-sales-june, which covers 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28.

Q028.covers: Counts June 2026 days on which recorded daily sales of 5 kg whole wheat atta exceeded 20 units (bags), using daily-sales-june for the eleven followed items.

Q029.covers: Counts distinct bills with till lines on 1 May 2026 in pos-lines-may-june, which holds only the eleven followed items, so this is a count of bills containing those items rather than all store bills.

Q030.cannot: No records cover July 2026: pos-payments-june (the approved-payment record for bills) ends on 2026-06-28, and no other table records bills or payments in July 2026.

Q031.covers: Daily units sold of ATTA-WW-5KG for each recorded day in June 2026 from daily-sales-june; May 2026 is not covered by this table, so the May-and-June average cannot be computed from it alone.

Q032.covers: Counts distinct June 2026 bills with an approved till payment, per the 'Bills and takings' definition; every June bill has exactly one approved payment.

Q033.covers: Reports the lowest recorded daily revenue for SUGAR-1KG across June 2026 from daily-sales-june, which covers only the eleven followed items.

plans.covers: Total units of SUGAR-1KG recorded as sold in daily-sales-june for June 2026 (followed items only).
Daily SUGAR-1KG units sold and revenue for the last week of June 2026 (2026-06-22 to 2026-06-28), to check whether sales actually fell.
Total SUGAR-1KG units sold in the preceding week (2026-06-15 to 2026-06-21) for comparison with the last week.

On-shelf availability evidence for SUGAR-1KG via 11:00 shelf audits in the last week (on-shelf availability definition); the cause of any sales fall is not recorded, so this is a labelled stand-in for shelf absence, not a recorded reason.
Forecast demand and recorded stock/order levels for both milk SKUs, using the forecast definition (a forecast predicts demand) as the basis for a stocking recommendation.
Recorded daily sales of both milk SKUs, the only observable proxy for actual demand (demand itself is not recorded).
On-shelf availability for both milk SKUs from 11:00 shelf audits (share of audits with status 'on shelf'), the shelf-side evidence that can contradict book stock.
Daily closing book stock for both milk SKUs (a belief about stock, not the shelf), to check whether recorded stock is running low against forecast demand.

Basket value is proxied by the total of the eleven followed items on each bill (a bill stands in for a shopper); the median bill value is the typical basket size, and the records do not cover the bill's other items.

Q037.covers: Daily units sold for BREAD-WHITE-400G from daily-sales-june for each June 2026 date, which can be averaged to give average units sold per day (covering only the eleven followed items).

plans.covers: Total units of ATTA-WW-5KG recorded as sold in daily-sales-june for June 2026 (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28), covering only the eleven followed items.
Total units of ATTA-WW-5KG recorded as sold in daily-sales-june for the week of 8 June 2026 (2026-06-08 to 2026-06-14), covering only the eleven followed items.
Week 1 (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-07) units sold per warehouse item from daily-sales-june.
Week 2 (2026-06-08 to 2026-06-14) units sold per warehouse item from daily-sales-june.
Checks the stated premise by listing daily units sold and revenue for 5 kg atta across 8–14 June 2026.
Checks whether 5 kg atta was recorded as 'on shelf' or 'empty' at the 11:00 shelf audits during 8–14 June 2026.
Checks the recorded book-stock belief for 5 kg atta on each day of 8–14 June 2026 (book stock is not the shelf).
Checks recorded warehouse stock corrections for 5 kg atta in 8–14 June 2026 and their stated reasons.

Q040.covers: The records can show whether sales fell and can show recorded shelf emptiness, book stock and stock-adjustment reasons for 5 kg atta in 8–14 June 2026, but no table records the cause of the fall, the demand behind it, or lost sales; the reply must present these as recorded evidence and a labelled stand-in, not a proven cause.

plans.covers: Recorded daily units and revenue for the 5 kg and 1 kg atta SKUs are compared over 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28 as a stand-in for switching; shopper identity, basket contents and the reason for any pack change are not recorded, so actual shopper switching cannot be established.

Q042.covers: Reports the recorded 28-day-mean forecast for 5 kg atta per day in June as a labelled stand-in for demand; actual demand is not recorded, and the forecast can only be scored against recorded sales.

plans.covers: Uses the 28-day-mean forecast for ATTA-WW-5KG over 23-26 June as a labelled stand-in for wanted demand; actual demand and lost sales are not recorded, so this is not a measured count of shoppers who wanted and did not find 5 kg atta.
Daily recorded units and revenue for 5 kg atta over 8–14 June, used to verify the stated 59% sales drop against the prior comparable week.
Daily closing book stock for 5 kg atta over 8–14 June, used to check the premise that the books showed stock on hand all week.
11:00 shelf-audit observations for 5 kg atta during 8–14 June, the on-shelf evidence that can contradict the book-stock belief.

Recorded sales for 5 kg and 1 kg atta over 8–14 June as a labelled stand-in for relative demand; shelf space, shelf dimensions, slot allocation and the cause of the sales drop are not recorded, so the actual space to reallocate cannot be computed from these records.

Q045.cannot: No table records shoppers who walked out without buying 5 kg atta: lost sales and shopper identities are not recorded, and a bill is only a proxy for a shopper who did buy.

Q046.covers: Sum of units_sold for ATTA-WW-5KG in daily-sales-june for June 2023; note the table's recorded coverage is 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28, so a 2023 date range may return no rows.

plans.covers: Products are grouped by their recorded flow (DC or DSD), and each flow's share of June 2026 revenue is computed from daily-sales-june revenue for the eleven followed items only (not the whole store).

Q048.covers: Counts distinct bill_id values in pos-lines-may-june that contain both ATTA-WW-5KG and DAL-TOOR-1KG lines.

Q049.covers: Uses the basket_value proxy: average basket value is the sum of till-line amounts per distinct bill divided by the number of distinct bills in each hour of June 2026, covering only the eleven followed items (pos-lines-may-june), not the whole store.
